name: uv (Python)
description: Installs the uv Python package and interpreter manager as a single static binary.

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.

python.description: Installs this CPython at build as the default (adds python/python3 to PATH). Empty installs no interpreter, leaving uv to use an available Python or download one on demand.

env.name: UV_CACHE_DIR
env.description: uv's cache in the state dir

env.name: UV_LINK_MODE
env.description: With copy, environments hold copies of the cached packages

env.name: UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS
env.description: With manual, Python versions a project asks for install on explicit request

env.name: UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR
env.description: uv's Python versions in the state dir

env.name: UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR
env.description: uv's tool commands in the state dir

env.name: UV_TOOL_DIR
env.description: uv's tools in the state dir
